title: Development of a fluorescence-based assay for RecBCD activity using functional data analysis and design of experiments
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,772-779
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00291A, Paper
Open Access

Adam Winnifrith, Steven R. Brown, Piotr Jedryszek, C. Grant, Philip E. Kay, Adam M. Thomas, Jacob D. Bradbury, Thomas Lanyon-Hogg
This work describes the rapid optimisation of a new fluorescence-based assay for RecBCD enzyme activity by integrating D-optimal design of experiments, functional data analysis, and automation.
